svg.title: Recovery across failure: historical checkpoint 4b578bf
svg.desc: Historical code schematic, not gameplay evidence. At commit 4b578bf, Netplay::Introduce keeps gone as the pending departure queue and polledGone as the in-flight HTTP snapshot. First poll copies A; B leaves while it is in flight. Failure retains A and B. Retry copies A and B; C leaves during the retry. HTTP 200 retires A and B only, leaving C queued, then clears the snapshot. Ticket blocks are illustrative. 404 clears old tickets. Poll intervals are 2 seconds, 5 seconds after 2 minutes, and 10 seconds after 10 minutes. Netplay::Leave sends kOver only when hosting and reopening, otherwise kBye. GaugeBoot at hook 0x000FAC clears g_gaugeSteps, while CrossFeverState serializes it under CFVS. Historical macOS arm64 evidence: 22 Worker tests, 7 protocol groups, 4500 matching gauge-reset frames.

g.aria-label: Pending departures survive failed requests. Only acknowledged tickets leave the queue.
Keep A + B. Clear the snapshot.
A + B are in flight; C stays queued.
Erase A + B. C survives the reply.
A / B / C are ticket symbols, not measured queue capacity.
Flush queued UDP first; send goodbye 3× per peer.
Ordinary match transitions keep the phase.
